DIAGNOSIS READY: Trisomy 21 (Down Syndrome) with Duodenal Atresia.

The patient's physical exam findings (epicanthus, single transverse palmar crease, heart murmur) confirm Down Syndrome, and in this context, bilious vomiting is highly suggestive of duodenal atresia ("double bubble" sign). The ultrasound results and meconium history were requested to support this clinical picture.
